title: Territory and forecast category
transcript:
Consultant: Anything else on the opportunity before we finish?
Client: Two things. First, we need a territory field on the opportunity so
we can split the pipeline report by region.
Consultant: Picklist of regions?
Client: Picklist, yes. North, south, and international.
Consultant: And the second?
Client: A forecast category on the opportunity as well, commit, best case
and pipeline. The sales director asks for it every single week.

expected.note: First of two requirements in one call.
Second of two; both are stated plainly.

notes: Tests recall when one transcript contains more than one requirement.
